title: Mochizuki Honami — Cool Rider Lady〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, your band's playing this weekend, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Do you think you'll be able to get to the live house okay?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We're all set! Our tickets even have maps drawn on the back!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Speaking of which, have you already invited Otori?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I did...
Unfortunately, she said she's going to be busy with her own shows that day.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
That's too bad.
I was holding out hoping that she'd be able to come with us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki was really hoping Tsukasa would be able to make it too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we'll be in more shows moving forward, so you should have plenty of other chances in the future.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
That's true too.
In any case, I can't wait to see this one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They should as long as they didn't get lost somewhere along the way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I see them...!
There! Towards the middle!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. Looks like they managed to get here in time.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wow... There's way more people here than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Where do you think we should stand?
Do think it's better to be off to the sides?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: N-No way. We wouldn't be able to see Honami at all from there. Let's try moving more towards the middle.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I understand that they're not used to coming to a place like this...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why I want to give them the best performance I can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku's here too along with everybody else.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's the case, we should be able to give them a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Stay in rhythm, and make each note count!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Wait, what's going on...?
Why is it so easy to play today?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Are we all feeling the same thing?)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Your show was completely off the hook!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Totally! I shouted so much that my voice was gone by the end of it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you both enjoyed it so much.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: We actually wanted to tell you this sooner. Our original plan was to wait for you guys by the exit with Hanasato and the others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You don't need to apologize. I really appreciate that you came to see us at all considering you also had cram school that day.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Seeing a show in person was just something else! It's like you could feel the music rushing through your body, you know?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was such an incredible feeling!
And you looked so cool on stage, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Definitely! Oh, before we forget...
Honami...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I was hoping to tell Hinomori and the rest of your band about the show... Do you think that'll be possible?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you two so much!
I'm sure they'll love to hear what you think!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, why don't I go with you?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You're a lifesaver! That'll make things so much easier!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This might be a good chance for them to get to know Shiho and the others better too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Especially since they're all my dear friends...)
